author: sbein
body:
This PR fixes a jet sorting issue in FastSim identified by @arizzi for Run 3 FastSim NanoAOD with Puppi jet refinement, which was originally merged here: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49429.

The above PR added refined Puppi jet quantities and sorted the main Jet table by the refined pT, but linkedObjects:jets and the MC/object association tables still followed the original jet order. In events where the refinement changes the jet ordering, some Jet_genJetIdx and MC extension rows can correspond to the wrong Jet.

The proposed fix (this PR) uses a clone of the pre-refined linked-object collection for the inputs to the refiner NN, then redirects the sorted linkedObjects.jets to finalJetsPuppiSorted. ```jetPuppiTable```` consumes linkedObjects,jets.

also: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51566
title: Fix FastSim NanoAOD jet row links
